name: Jjimjilbang: Plan Guest Paths
summary:
Guests in a Korean bathhouse follow a path, and you are the one who lays it out. From the shoe locker to the changing lockers, the tubs, the kiln sauna, a cup of sikhye and the sleep room, thirteen routes run through the building: cut a path and the guest simply goes home, and when a spot fills up a line forms with a waiting tag showing which facility is holding everyone up.

Placement decides earnings, and a multiplier preview appears before anything is set down, so a sleep room next to the arcade is too noisy to pay well. Across seven stages the building widens from a neighborhood bathhouse into a spa land, opening new facilities among thirty in all and drawing six kinds of guests, from aunties and students to office workers and tourists, who can be won over into regulars with a story saved in the guest book.
